Hi Alex — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can lock the sizing call: 

Recap (high level):
- Primary workload: endpoint serving for contextual search + summarization across support docs
- Expected traffic pattern: 5–15 QPS steady, spikes to ~60 QPS for batch runs (daily)
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile <= 250ms for search responses; summarization can tolerate up to 600ms
- Model family: planning to evaluate 13B open weights; possible quantized variants if needed
- Data residency: US only (no egress outside region)

What we need for the sizing call:
- A 60-minute technical deep dive with your infra/ML engineer to review traffic traces, tokenization profile, and concurrency expectations
- Clarify whether you want a reserved Dedicated pool vs. burstable; we'll bring cost/delivery tradeoffs

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue May 4 — 10:00–11:00am PT
- Wed May 5 — 2:00–3:00pm PT
- Thu May 6 — 9:00–10:00am PT

I attached our dedicated intake template — if you can drop a short load summary (QPS by endpoint, typical input lengths) into the CSV prior to the call it will help us come prepared.
